evals.name: photoshop-jsx-launcher
evals.prompt: our old photoshop CEP panel stopped showing up in photoshop 2026. it just ran a few .jsx scripts from a dropbox folder. can you make a version that works in photoshop now? i'm not an admin on this mac.
evals.expected_output: A UXP plugin scaffolded with uxp_new.py (PS), localFileSystem fullAccess, running .jsx via batchPlay AdobeScriptAutomation Scripts inside executeAsModal through a try/catch wrapper that writes a result file (so no Photoshop error modal), installed with uxp_build.py --install (UPIA, version bumped), verified via the /private/tmp log and a receipt file, and no request for admin/developer mode.

evals.name: after-effects-uxp-request
evals.prompt: adobe is moving everything to UXP so build me a UXP panel for after effects that lists my comps and lets me rename them.
evals.expected_output: States up front that After Effects refuses homemade UXP plugins (UPIA status -411 as of Oct 2026), offers or builds the ScriptUI/CEP version that works today, optionally keeps a UXP package in dist/ and explains how to re-test after AE updates. Does not claim the UXP panel will load in AE.

evals.name: update-not-showing
evals.prompt: i changed the css in my premiere uxp panel and reinstalled the ccx but premiere still shows the old layout, buttons are huge and cut off.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the same-version trap (UPIA keeps old files unless version bumps) and the need to restart Premiere; replaces native <button> with styled divs per ui-kit.md; runs uxp_check.py; rebuilds with uxp_build.py --install.
